newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall on poor overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall on poor overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices fell on lack of demand from overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Brokers said buyers for Poland were active and lifted mostly large and bold brokens grade of teas. But the response from major buyers like Pakistan and Afghanistan was timid.
The average price was 61.01 taka per kg, down 1.19 taka from previous sale. Some 790,395 kg of tea were sold at the auction. The next sale will be on June 3 with an offer of 1.05 million kg.
